introduction: Choose one surviving thief guild, earn Lord Lenbrea’s trust, and follow his time-portal and vault rewards. Keep the merchant’s paired crate delivery and the captain’s legacy scroll exchange distinct from actual travel, stat gains and epic training.
orientation: Enter from the Surface forest onto the paved road at Ceothia’s southern edge. Cyraes Way connects the town north to south; Trenathal and Asahtoan Ways lead around the merchant square. Ordinary shops, inns and clerks do not grant quest achievements just by being visited.

Ask Lord Lenbrea about hello, legacy, service or town, then task. He wants one thief guild to remain. Choose a surviving leader before collecting the other three different badges; each leader wears their own badge, while ordinary guild thieves do not. Supplied badges skip personal kills and the native exchanges do not enforce a permanent faction choice.

Moonstone waits at the damp alley’s far end, jade wyrm at the lightless alley’s far end. Search and open the secret eastern door in the dim alley for red shadow, or the secret northern door in the smelly alley for violet death. Native closed doors and secret discovery still apply.

All four bargains give the same Ceothian thief-guild badge, with different gifts: moonstone’s platinum eyepatch, jade wyrm’s amethyst bracelet, red shadow’s ruby-buckle belt or violet death’s gold-lined boots. The chosen giver leaves. One accepted bargain completes the shared journal card; its four alternatives are not four required campaign stages.

Give Lenbrea the common badge for the bluestone key and 500,000 copper. Unlock and open the western audience-chamber door to the storeroom; the door is pickproof and the key breaks when used. ENTER the shimmering portal goes to past Ceothia. An open door or supplied later proof bypasses earlier personal history.

Lenbrea separately accepts future Ceothia’s flickering dragon horn for the demonic ogre-warlord sword and 500,000 copper, or the Chronomancer’s thread of time for a glowing vault key. The huge beholder supplies the horn. The return portal in future Ceothia leads back to the present audience chamber. Exact supplied proofs need no personal timeline journey.

The glowing key unlocks the pickproof northern vault door and breaks when used. The vault’s imported glowing pool has its own DRINK agility effect, level requirement and shared two-day pool cooldown. A denied or capped drink is not a positive stat gain; obtaining the key is not proof of entering or using the pool. A dormant skill-beacon table mentioning this room does not place a beacon here.

Two exact oaken crates lie inside the closed, locked wagon on the southern cobblestone road. One of the three bored guards beside it carries the tiny iron key, which may break on use. Get two separate crates and bring them to the merchant guard waiting in the Steel Mug taproom for 200,000 copper. The crates are other-type quest items rather than containers; the fixed wagon need not be picked up.

The captain’s legacy recipe asks for Bel’s heart, the orb of unmaking and the mystic runed tablet for a Dexterity scroll. No current fresh tablet source or bound scroll-learning effect was found. The captain also teaches epic Dexterity and the butcher teaches Toughness through separate PRACTICE purchases, which remain unavailable while economic accounting is active.

The General Store is the only shop definition in this area; other shop descriptions are not proof of shopping support. Five rooms have explicit inn bindings. The Golden Cat taproom offers separate ship crew services. The local level potion also has foreign and procedural sources, without becoming a Ceothian quest hand-in.

Guild survival, earning trust, entering the past, returning future proofs and using the vault form a story in the lore. Their exact native exchanges remain independent, without an enforced all-stage campaign or proof that the timeline has changed. New campaign, source, access, custom effect and renewal credit requires admitted events and recovery qualification.

Discovery has its own achievement, and meeting the terminal givers reveals the relevant journal cards. Dialogue, current loose materials and exact accepted outcomes stay distinct. Active, ready accounting is required for all new discovery, encounter, journal, achievement and daily credit; frozen reward recovery is separate.

contacts.name: the leader of the moonstone thieves
contacts.description: At the end of the south-eastern damp alley. Bring the jade wyrm, red shadow and violet death badges; gives the common badge and platinum eyepatch, then leaves.

contacts.name: the leader of the jade wyrm thieves
contacts.description: At the end of the northern lightless alley. Bring moonstone, red shadow and violet death badges; gives the common badge and amethyst bracelet, then leaves.

contacts.name: Lord Lenbrea
contacts.description: In the manor audience chamber. Ask hello, legacy, service or town, then task. The common badge, flickering horn and thread of time each have their own exact reward. Earlier personal dialogue and travel are not required by those recipes.

contacts.name: the leader of the red shadow thieves
contacts.description: Behind the secret eastern door in the north-eastern dim alley. Bring violet death, moonstone and jade wyrm badges; gives the common badge and ruby-buckle belt, then leaves.

contacts.name: the leader of the violet death thieves
contacts.description: In the meeting hall beyond the secret northern door in the south-western smelly alley. Bring moonstone, jade wyrm and red shadow badges; gives the common badge and gold-lined boots, then leaves.

contacts.name: a merchant guard
contacts.description: Waiting in the Steel Mug taproom. Ask hello, hi or howdy. Accepts two exact oaken crates for 200,000 copper; other merchant-guard prototypes do not own this request.

contacts.name: the captain of the Ceothian Guard
contacts.description: In the Ceothian Guard barracks. Owns the legacy three-item scroll exchange and separately teaches epic Dexterity through PRACTICE. His qc_action lines are timed room messages, not addressed topics or command numbers.

contacts.name: a bloody butcher
contacts.description: In the butcher shop north of the merchant square. Separately teaches Toughness through the computed epic-teacher table; ordinary carcass prose does not make every corpse a quest item.

contacts.name: a bored merchant guard
contacts.description: Three instances stand beside the southern merchant wagon; only the middle reset carries the tiny iron key. The recipient waiting in the Steel Mug is a different merchant guard.

contacts.name: a homely woman
contacts.description: Keeps the General Store north of the merchant square. The area has one actual shop definition; the many other described shops do not acquire shopping or quest handlers from their names.

contacts.name: a Ceothian vault guard
contacts.description: The vault guard starts inside Lenbrea’s locked northern vault. The glowing key gives access; defeating this guard is not a native requirement for Lenbrea’s thread hand-in.

contacts.name: a beautiful young barmaid
contacts.description: At the Golden Cat taproom. LIST/HIRE is bound to the room as a ship crew service, requiring ship ownership and its normal eligibility. Hiring and inn services are separate from local quest outcomes.

contacts.name: a Du'Maathe castle guard
contacts.description: The visiting Du’Maathe castle messenger starts in the manor waiting room. His report and Lenbrea’s warning connect the lore without adding a local dialogue, delivery or castle-restoration requirement.

contacts.name: a huge beholder
contacts.description: The huge beholder in future Ceothia starts with the exact flickering horn in the rare-load dispersal room. Its actual presence and location may change; no personal source kill is required for an exact supplied horn.

contacts.name: The Chronomancer
contacts.description: In future Ceothia’s Vortex of Time. Starts carrying the exact thread requested by present-day Lenbrea. Reaching or defeating this actor alone is not the accepted hand-in.

contacts.name: Bel, the lord of the First
contacts.description: Bel, lord of the First, in the Blood Citadel starts carrying the exact heart requested by the captain and other recipients. The heart has a handling trap; source recovery remains separate from delivery.

contacts.name: the Dark
contacts.description: The Dark in the Negative Material Plane wears the exact orb of unmaking. Ownership, removal and choosing a recipient are separate from Ceothia’s accepted legacy exchange.
